# @three-ws/agent-runtime

> The three.ws agent engine: a plan/execute decision loop with human-approval gates, a seven-layer GuardChain (security blacklist, intervention, capability, permission, trade guard, spend envelope, x402 budget), a tamper-evident hash-chained action ledger, and a multi-step transaction pipeline with rollback.

@three-ws/agent-runtime is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/agent-runtime`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-runtime/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/agent-runtime/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/agent-runtime/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-runtime/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
